Being subjected to this level of constant recurring rage isn't healthy.

@CDCDirector is right that racism and having to deal with it is a public health threat. 😠😠😠🤬 #BlackLivesMatter

If #GeorgeFloyd were a dog, there would be ZERO question about the outcome of a trial about his killing. Sit on that. 

My Black life matters, damnit. I refuse to EXPECT injustice. I am waiting to hear "GUILTY." If we don't I am NOT wrong; just God help us. 

#BlackLivesMatter
